# GM Mohit - Portfolio and AI Context

This is the portfolio of GM Mohit, a Creative Developer and UI/UX Designer who specializes in building highly aesthetic, brutalist, and physics-driven digital experiences.

## Core Identity
- **Name:** GM Mohit
- **Roles:** Creative Developer, UI/UX Architect, Digital Craftsman
- **Website:** https://www.gmmohit.com
- **Philosophy:** "I build digital experiences where elegance meets intention. I help ambitious brands break through the noise with design that doesn't just look stunning—it performs."

## Services & Expertise
1. **Strategy & Direction:** Defining core purpose and pathways to elevate digital presence.
2. **Visual Design:** Creating pixel-perfect, brutalist, and highly aesthetic interfaces that demand attention.
3. **Creative Development:** Bringing static pixels to life with physics-driven motion, WebGL, and precise implementation.

## Technical Stack
- Next.js & React
- WebGL & Three.js
- Framer Motion (Physics & Interaction)
- Tailwind CSS
